failedEvidence.initialRed: The existing distinctiveness detector selects a loud snare and misses the Creep bar.
failedEvidence.invalidRun: One check reused generated files during another compile. Its result is invalid and retained as overlapping-check-invalid.log. Later runs use unique temporary folders.
failedEvidence.excerptAssumption: A 32-second excerpt was initially expected to establish Creep’s bar. It remains inconclusive. The target regression now freezes the full-song beat features and asserts bar zero; the short-excerpt test asserts uncertainty and preserved beat alignment.
failedEvidence.intermediateSourceBinding: Intermediate edited source snapshots were not sealed for every failure. The final source hashes bind the passing checks; logs remain preserved.
